messages.author: eef7c899899f77ee
messages.subject: Error when run "PDtoMSstatsTMTFormat"
parts:
Hi MSstats Team,

When I am trying to run the "PDtoMSstatsTMTFormat" on my Windows, the following error occurs:
Error in .checkAnnotation(input, annotation) : 
  ** Columns Run missing in the annotation. Please check the annotation file.

However, when I run the same file on my MacBook, it goes through. 
I am using R version 4.1.1 on Windows and 3.6.3 on MacBook. 
Is there a problem by using different R version to run MSstatsTMT?
I had tried different R version on my Windows, none of them solved the problems.

Second question, after I convert the format from PD to MSstatsTMT, I am not able to run the quant.msstats, but I can run quant.median on my MacBook. Can you please explain what the reason is? What's more, after I run test.contrast, there is no value under FC, pvalue and such. Could you please help me to solve the problem?

Thanks,

messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: Error when run "PDtoMSstatsTMTFormat"
parts:
Hi,


please provide a small subset of data that will help us reproduce the error. You can anonymize the data by changing protein/peptide/condition labels.
With R version 4.1.1 Bioconductor install the latest version of MSstats and MSstatsTMT, while version 3.6.3 install previous release of MSstatsTMT.

Kind regards,
Mateusz

parts:
The new script works with latest R version?
Which older version worked with the previous script?


The option useNumProteinsColumn uses column names from previous version of PD. The output format changed and we didn't have a chance to adjust to these changes, yet. With FALSE, the non-existing column is not used, so there is no problem.

Kind regards,
Mateusz
